about: Every GTA V game system the mashup touches. One row = one system = one C++ struct/module.

rows.summary: Mod does nothing unless the player is in story mode; unloads its behaviour if GTA Online starts.
Spawns the Neighbor ped at his house and keeps him there between visits.
State machine (patrol, suspicious, chase, catch, set trap, return home) driven by the neighbor_states sheet.
Remembers where the player got caught or entered and places a trap from the traps sheet on that route next time.
House doors stay locked until the player carries the item that opens them.
When the Neighbor catches the player: screen fades, player wakes up back at home instead of dying.
After enough catches the Neighbor calls the cops: GTA wanted stars on the next break-in.
Objectives text and blip from 'new neighbor moved in' to 'what is in the basement'.
Keeps catches, learned trap spots and found items in a small file next to the mod so a session can be resumed.
